    """Answer only API (xhr/fetch) requests; let the app shell load normally."""

    def handler(route):
        if route.request.resource_type in ("xhr", "fetch"):

                content_type="application/json",
                body=json.dumps(body) if body is not None else "",

    page.route("**/*", handler)
